steps.title: Male-specific cells
steps.narration: 1,258 neurons labeled male-specific. Most sit in the central brain — this is the sex-specific circuit this connectome was built to see.

steps.title: P1 command cluster
steps.narration: pC1 cells are the male courtship command cluster in the central brain. They drive the rest of this pathway.

steps.title: mAL
steps.narration: Male-specific mAL neurons couple the command cluster to downstream courtship circuitry.

steps.title: Descending courtship
steps.narration: pIP10, aSP22, and DNp13 carry courtship and song commands out of the brain, down the neck, into the VNC.

steps.title: Song motor
steps.narration: vPR6 and TN1c in the ventral nerve cord pattern courtship song.

steps.title: Visual tracking
steps.narration: LC10 visual projection neurons track a moving fly and feed the same courtship cluster. Sampled across both optic lobes.
